page.overview:
Who is Syndilian Shanyr?

Syndilian Shanyr, also known as Syndillian the Traveller, is an Asuryani Pathfinder who hales from Craftworld Il-Kaithe.

He has been sent by the Farseers of his craftworld to prevent the fulfillment of an ancient prophecy predicting that a gateway to the heart of the galaxy in the Eastern Fringe would be claimed by a malevolent force.

To this end, he has been operating within the Jericho Reach, conducting a campaign of subversion, assassination and deflection in pursuit of a goal unknown to the Imperium.

As such, he has been identified as a high-priority target by the Deathwatch of the Reach.
